info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Deliverys-v4-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Delivery API provides access to detailed information about prescription deliveries within a pharmacy system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of scheduled prescription deliveries, enhancing visibility into delivery operations. Typical consumers of this API include pharmacy staff and logistics teams, who utilize this information to ensure timely and accurate patient care. By leveraging this API, pharmacies can streamline their delivery processes and improve overall service quality.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch delivery information related to your prescriptions, including status, expected delivery date, and other relevant details.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve prescription delivery information. This body should include any necessary parameters specified by the API for retrieving the relevant data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved delivery information for prescriptions.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsDeliverysReques.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to prescriptions delivery.
